reviewSamples.author: Marcial Ilas
reviewSamples.text: Bees started building a hive near the eaves, creating fear of stings. The technician safely removed the hive, relocated bees responsibly, and explained protective measures. The combination of efficiency and safety left everyone feeling secure and grateful for the considerate approach.

reviewSamples.author: Linda Wilson
reviewSamples.text: I utilized them to exterminate bed bugs, and they are without a doubt the best pest control service in the area. They offer quality service at a reasonable price. The support team is exceptional since they are dependable, forthcoming, and communicative. All my close friends and relatives are aware that I suggest them strongly!

reviewSamples.author: George Weber
reviewSamples.text: I used a pest control service not too long ago and they were fantastic. They showed up when they said they would, and in a day they had eradicated the entire colony of termites. I have no complaints about the work they did for me and will gladly refer them to anyone who needs assistance with a similar issue.

reviewSamples.author: Wayne Kahn
reviewSamples.text: I do not know how they do it, but these pest control companies are really good at their jobs. They will always find the best solutions for even my most difficult cases. It's just that I would recommend them to anyone that needs a home inspection done.

reviewSamples.author: Daphne Dykstra
reviewSamples.text: Our technician came quickly and performed the treatment well. I suggest this company.

email_search: WebSearch for business name + address + 'email contact' and for name + phone + 'facebook' found third-party aggregator/directory pages (lantern.llc, reviews.birdeye.com, bugs.com, nativepestmanagement.com) but no owned website, no Facebook page, and no public email for this business.
city_note: Verified address is Riviera Beach, FL 33404 (not West Palm Beach as initially assumed before verification); kept the real, Maps-verified city per the zero-invented-data rule.
language_source: English-language Google Maps listing, English reviews, English business name; no evidence of a Spanish-speaking customer base.
motivo_fallo: Insufficient authentic photo assets. The Google Maps listing has only 3 photos total; 2 are a byte-identical, unrelated warehouse/logistics photo with no connection to pest control (misattributed, not of this business) and the 3rd is a stock marketing graphic with text overlay rather than a real photo of the business. Zero genuinely usable, business-specific photos remain, well short of the 5-6 minimum required, and the hard rule against filling gaps with photos that are not of this business means no site could be built without either fabricating content or misrepresenting an unrelated business as this one. Construction was stopped before writing content.json/index.html.
